questions.question_text: The customer billing and payment system shall send an email notification when a workflow step is assigned to a user.
The customer billing and payment system shall support retention rules that can be set by record type.
The customer billing and payment system should allow users to save and share filtered views.
The customer billing and payment system shall take a daily backup that can be restored to any point within the previous 14 days.
The customer billing and payment system should support electronic signatures that are legally binding in Alberta.
The customer billing and payment system shall support full-text search across all records the user is permitted to see.
The customer billing and payment system should provision users automatically from Microsoft Entra ID.
The customer billing and payment system shall support single sign-on with the identity provider used by the Utility.
The customer billing and payment system shall provide read-only access for auditors.
The customer billing and payment system shall provide bulk import of records from CSV files, listing validation errors by row.
The customer billing and payment system shall enforce multi-factor authentication for all administrative users.
The customer billing and payment system shall support role-based access control with at least five configurable roles.
The customer billing and payment system should provide a mobile application for iOS and Android.
The customer billing and payment system shall allow administrators to define fields and pick lists without code changes.
The customer billing and payment system shall work on current versions of Chrome, Edge, Safari and Firefox without plug-ins.
The customer billing and payment system should allow business users to configure workflow steps without vendor assistance.
Disclose any litigation or claims against your organization in the last five years that relate to services of this kind.
Describe your approach to social procurement, including Indigenous, local and diversity-owned subcontracting.
Describe at least two comparable projects completed in the last five years, including scope, duration and outcome.
The Proponent must describe how rate changes are configured and applied to bills that span the effective date.
The Proponent must confirm that online payments are processed in a PCI DSS compliant manner (Yes/No).
Please describe the interface with the meter data management system, including data volumes and frequency.
Attach your most recent audited financial statements.
The Proponent shall attach a certificate of insurance showing commercial general liability coverage of not less than $5,000,000.
questions.constraints: commercial general liability of not less than $5,000,000

questions.question_text: The Proponent must state every assumption and exclusion that affects the prices quoted.
The Proponent shall confirm that its prices will be held for 120 days after the Closing Time (Yes/No).
